purpose: Runtime calibration of the current initial candidate; not a performance comparison or paper reproduction

profile.name: search
profile.purpose: Reduced GA development budget; disjoint from final reporting seeds

nominal_steps_note: 80 generations × 64 population × 3 training rollouts × 500-step cap; excludes evaluation and may include rollout padding after termination.
timing_note: One candidate measurement with sequential fresh training processes; includes imports, compilation, training and scoring. Environment probe is excluded. Model proposals, review and retry overhead are excluded. Seed variation is not an estimate of across-candidate timing uncertainty.
artifact_policy: Text artifacts are published with local repository paths replaced by $REPO_ROOT. Original and published hashes are recorded. Binary checkpoints remain local and their original hashes are recorded.
preflight_failure: A package-metadata lookup for vendored evosax failed before training. The probe was corrected to enumerate installed distributions. Both the failure record and successful run are retained.
